notes: Three co-transmitters at one level, one group; the dashed «واللفظ لأبي بكر» is a gloss and is left out.

Mughira and Muhammad ibn Maslama speak inside Miswar's story of Umar's consultation; whether Mughira's testimony is a source or only in the scene is a narrated encounter (rule 11), so the last link is not settled here.
«أبيه» is a bare relation with no name.
